data.description: Contains hierarchical data for universities, institutes, campuses, and programs.

university_name.description: Full or short name of the university (e.g., TU, KU, PU)

faculties.description: List of faculties, schools, or institutes under the university

name.description: Name of the faculty or institute (e.g., Institute of Engineering - IOE)

notification_page_link.description: Main notification or scrape link for this institute/faculty

notification_type.description: Different types of notification filters available

colleges.description: Constituent or affiliated campuses/colleges under this institute

name.description: Name of the specific campus or college

notification_type.description: Different types of notification filters available for this college/campus

link.description: Website link for the specific college or campus

programs.description: Programs offered by this specific college/campus
